### 💡 Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the capability or improvement you would like to see in ForgeX.

### 🎯 Motivation & Engineering Impact
Explain why this feature is valuable and which phase/agent in the ForgeX pipeline it impacts:
- [ ] Requirements Decomposition (Phase 8)
- [ ] RAG Repository Ingestion & pgvector (Phase 9)
- [ ] Autonomous Coding Agent & Branch Isolation (Phase 12)
- [ ] Automated Test Generation (Phase 13)
- [ ] DevSecOps Sentinel & SAST (Phase 15)
- [ ] AI Trust Score Gate (Phase 16)
- [ ] Production Observability & AI Project Manager (Phase 20-21)

### 📐 Proposed Architecture & Implementation
Describe the technical design, endpoints, entities, or prompt structures needed.

### 🛡️ Safety & Quality Gates
Describe how this feature complies with branch isolation, test verification, and human approval gates.
